BiblicalUsage: Nachash as a noun means an enchantment or augury, a forbidden way of seeking knowledge, and it belongs to Balaam's story. In Numbers 23:23 Balaam says there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither any divination against Israel, and in Numbers 24:1 he goes not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but sets his face toward the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that enchantment is the search for power without obedience, and Balaam learned it does not work against a people God has blessed; no spell can curse what God has decided to bless.
